Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class SocketOptions.Builder<T extends SocketOptions.Builder<T>>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.SocketOptions.Builder<T>
  • Type Parameters:
    T - the concrete builder type
    Enclosing class:
    SocketOptions
    public abstract static class SocketOptions.Builder<T extends SocketOptions.Builder<T>>
extends Object
    Base builder for configuring common socket options.

    Concrete builders extend this class to provide additional transport-specific configuration options and construct the corresponding SocketOptions implementation.

      • withReuseAddress

        public T withReuseAddress​(boolean value)
        Configures whether the socket may reuse its local address.

      • withReceiveBufferSize

        public T withReceiveBufferSize​(int value)
        Configures the socket receive buffer size.

        The specified size is requested from the underlying socket implementation. The effective size may differ depending on the operating system.

        Parameters:
        value - the requested receive buffer size in bytes; must be greater than zero
        Returns:
        this builder
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if value is not greater than zero

      • withSendBufferSize

        public T withSendBufferSize​(int value)
        Configures the socket send buffer size.

        The specified size is requested from the underlying socket implementation. The effective size may differ depending on the operating system.

        Parameters:
        value - the requested send buffer size in bytes; must be greater than zero
        Returns:
        this builder
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if value is not greater than zero

      • withTrafficClass

        public T withTrafficClass​(int value)

        Returns:

        Throws:
